reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (New Hampshire, focus year 2021)
    Question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for refusal of new lease terms?
    Encodes relevant parts of:
      - NH RSA 356-C:3 (2021)  (condominium conversion notices; timing; vacate protections)
      - NH RSA 356-C:6 (2021)  (eviction protection after conversion notice)
      - NH RSA 540:2 (2021)    (termination/eviction grounds; restricted vs nonrestricted;
                                rent increase refusal as good cause with 30-day notice;
                                "other good cause" includes legitimate business/economic reason)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Context (state/year)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

jurisdiction(new_hampshire).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).
property(p1).

tenancy(t1, p1).
landlord_of(l1, p1).

/* The question asks generally about refusal of new lease terms, including:
   - refusal to sign a lease extension
   - refusal to agree to a fair rent increase
   - refusal to agree to lease changes at renewal
*/
tenant_refused_new_terms(t1, p1, lease_extension).
tenant_refused_new_terms(t1, p1, rent_increase).
tenant_refused_new_terms(t1, p1, renewal_lease_changes).

/* Facts relevant to RSA 540:2 IV (rent increase refusal good cause):
   Landlord provided written notice of amount and effective date >= 30 days in advance.
*/
rent_increase_notice_days_before_effective(p1, 30).

/* Optional narrative label in the question ("fair rent increase"). RSA 540:2 IV does not
   require "fairness" as a condition; RSA 356-C:6 has special limits during condo conversion.
*/
rent_increase_characterization(p1, fair).

/* Property type matters in RSA 540:2:
   - nonrestricted: can terminate with notice to quit (no-cause termination)
   - restricted: can terminate only for listed reasons (including "other good cause")
   For this scenario, we model a restricted tenancy because the question is about whether refusal
   can be "good cause" (RSA 540:2 IV and V).
*/
property_type(p1, restricted).

/* Condo conversion chapter (RSA 356-C) only restricts evictions AFTER a proper conversion notice.
   The question does not state a condo conversion, so we set: no conversion notice served.
*/
conversion_notice_served_under_356c3(p1, no).

/* For completeness, we also encode that the landlord has legitimate business/economic reasons
   to insist on renewal/extension terms (RSA 540:2 V "other good cause").
*/
landlord_legitimate_business_reason(p1, lease_extension).
landlord_legitimate_business_reason(p1, renewal_lease_changes).

/* Helper predicate summarizing the scenario as a reusable logical statement. */
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(new_hampshire),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    property(p1),
    tenancy(t1, p1),
    landlord_of(l1, p1),
    tenant_refused_new_terms(t1, p1, lease_extension),
    tenant_refused_new_terms(t1, p1, rent_increase),
    tenant_refused_new_terms(t1, p1, renewal_lease_changes).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* =========================
   RSA 356-C:3 (2021)
   Provision of Rights; Contents of Notice (condo conversion protections)
   ========================= */

/* Whether RSA 356-C eviction protections are triggered:
   RSA 356-C:6 begins: "Once notice has been served ... in accordance with RSA 356-C:3..."
*/
statute_356c3_notice_served(Property) :-
    conversion_notice_served_under_356c3(Property, yes), !.
statute_356c3_notice_served(_Property) :-
    !, fail.

/* RSA 356-C:3 I(a)(7): tenant gets "no less than 270 days" from receipt of notice before vacate
   (subject to longer valid leasehold rights).
   RSA 356-C:3 I(a)(8): elderly or disabled: at least 18 months from receipt of notice.
   We encode the baseline minimum vacate days, ignoring "exclusive right to purchase" timing
   complexities because they are not needed to answer this question.
*/
statute_356c3_minimum_vacate_days(Tenant, Days) :-
    tenant_elderly_or_disabled(Tenant, yes), !,
    Days is 18 * 30.  % 18 months represented as 540 days for numeric reasoning
statute_356c3_minimum_vacate_days(_Tenant, 270) :-
    !.

/* Tenant status (not part of question; defaults to no). */
tenant_elderly_or_disabled(_Tenant, no) :- !.

/* RSA 356-C:3 I(a): notice must be mailed; timing: "no earlier than 120 days before filing".
   We encode the numeric threshold as a constant.
*/
statute_356c3_notice_must_be_at_least_days_before_filing(120) :- !.

/* RSA 356-C:3 I(a)(12): if there is a rent increase (except certain ones), application for
   conversion shall not be made until 3 months after such increase.
*/
statute_356c3_conversion_application_wait_months_after_rent_increase(3) :- !.


/* =========================
   RSA 356-C:6 (2021)
   Eviction Protection (after conversion notice)
   ========================= */

/* RSA 356-C:6: after notice under RSA 356-C:3, tenant shall not be evicted except on listed grounds. */
statute_356c6_eviction_allowed_ground(nonpayment_of_rent_or_reasonable_charges) :- !.
statute_356c6_eviction_allowed_ground(failure_to_comply_with_material_terms_after_notice_and_opportunity) :- !.
statute_356c6_eviction_allowed_ground(damage_and_failure_to_repair) :- !.
statute_356c6_eviction_allowed_ground(repeated_disturbance_of_peace_and_quiet) :- !.
statute_356c6_eviction_allowed_ground(expiration_of_356c3_notice_period) :- !.
statute_356c6_eviction_allowed_ground(elderly_or_disabled_no_longer_in_residence_if_applicable) :- !.

/* If 356-C:6 applies (conversion notice served), then only those grounds are permitted.
   This predicate is used as a "block" against RSA 540:2-based reasons when 356-C:6 applies.
*/
statute_356c6_blocks_other_eviction_reasons(Property) :-
    statute_356c3_notice_served(Property), !.
statute_356c6_blocks_other_eviction_reasons(_Property) :-
    !, fail.


/* =========================
   RSA 540:2 (2021)
   Termination of Tenancy
   ========================= */

/* RSA 540:2 I: nonrestricted property: may terminate any tenancy by notice to quit. */
statute_5402_nonrestricted_may_terminate_with_notice(Property) :-
    property_type(Property, nonrestricted), !.
statute_5402_nonrestricted_may_terminate_with_notice(_Property) :-
    !, fail.

/* RSA 540:2 II: restricted property: may terminate only for listed reasons. We encode relevant ones. */
statute_5402_restricted_property(Property) :-
    property_type(Property, restricted), !.
statute_5402_restricted_property(_Property) :-
    !, fail.

/* RSA 540:2 II(e) & V: "Other good cause" includes legitimate business/economic reason and
   need not be based on tenant action/inaction. */
statute_5402_other_good_cause_legitimate_business(Property, Topic) :-
    statute_5402_restricted_property(Property),
    landlord_legitimate_business_reason(Property, Topic), !.
statute_5402_other_good_cause_legitimate_business(_Property, _Topic) :-
    !, fail.

/* RSA 540:2 IV: refusal to agree to a change in existing rental agreement calling for an increase
   in rent is "good cause" under II(e) IF landlord gave written notice of amount and effective date
   >= 30 days before effective date. */
statute_5402_good_cause_rent_increase_refusal(Property) :-
    statute_5402_restricted_property(Property),
    rent_increase_notice_days_before_effective(Property, Days),
    integer(Days),
    Days >= 30, !.
statute_5402_good_cause_rent_increase_refusal(_Property) :-
    !, fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning: apply statutes to scenario facts
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* If RSA 356-C:6 applies, it blocks eviction for "refusal of new lease terms" as such,
   unless it can be characterized as one of the enumerated grounds (not modeled here).
   In the question scenario, no conversion notice was served, so no block.
*/
not_blocked_by_356c6(Property) :-
    statute_356c6_blocks_other_eviction_reasons(Property), !, fail.
not_blocked_by_356c6(_Property) :-
    !.

/* Determine whether eviction is legally supported (in this scenario) due to a particular refusal.
   This answers the question's three variants.
*/
legal_eviction_due_to_refusal(Property, rent_increase) :-
    tenant_refused_new_terms(_Tenant, Property, rent_increase),
    not_blocked_by_356c6(Property),
    statute_5402_good_cause_rent_increase_refusal(Property), !.

legal_eviction_due_to_refusal(Property, lease_extension) :-
    tenant_refused_new_terms(_Tenant, Property, lease_extension),
    not_blocked_by_356c6(Property),
    (
        statute_5402_nonrestricted_may_terminate_with_notice(Property)
    ;
        statute_5402_other_good_cause_legitimate_business(Property, lease_extension)
    ),
    !.

legal_eviction_due_to_refusal(Property, renewal_lease_changes) :-
    tenant_refused_new_terms(_Tenant, Property, renewal_lease_changes),
    not_blocked_by_356c6(Property),
    (
        statute_5402_nonrestricted_may_terminate_with_notice(Property)
    ;
        statute_5402_other_good_cause_legitimate_business(Property, renewal_lease_changes)
    ),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final QA predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    legal_eviction_due_to_refusal(p1, _WhichRefusal),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for refusal of new lease terms? This includes when the law allows for eviction if the tenant refused to sign a lease extension; refused to agree to a fair rent increase; or refused to agree to lease changes at the time of renewal
